version: v4 draft (2026-11-15). v3 + B-guard supplement and error-consequence recording; proposed before any new-dev run, final freeze after user review (priority step 3). v3 kept in history/config_v3_2026-11-15.json.
candidates: oracle only: answer-key small_pallet boxes of frame 0, ids by x (1 = leftmost); the same boxes are used for frames 1-2 (static scene, fixed camera)

smoke.purpose: format and GPU memory only on EXP110 dev P01-P04; no answer key is read, no accuracy is computed, answers are not printed

crop.source: EXP111 s3 crop = EXP110 X4 oracle crop (set before EXP112)

overlay: white numbered boxes on every candidate (EXP120 neutral_overlay)
state_prompt: Look at the small pallet {where}. Which blocks are lying on top of this pallet? Count only blocks that sit on the pallet surface, not blocks on the floor next to it. Return JSON only: {{"blocks_on_pallet": [<"red" or "blue">, ...]}} (an empty list if the pallet is empty).

where.Z-full: marked with box number {k} in the image
where.Z-crop: at the center of this image
where.Z-both: marked with box number {k} in the first image; the second image is an enlarged view of the same pallet

parse_rule: JSON object with key blocks_on_pallet whose value is a list of strings, else invalid. Colours are compared after lower() and strip() only; any other string counts as a wrong colour, not as invalid.

b_rule.prompt: EXP110 config qwen.c1_prompt and c1_max_new_tokens (unchanged, as EXP111 s4)
b_rule.state_rule: LOADED if the centre of any predicted block box (any of the 4 queries) lies inside the pallet box; colours from the colour queries the same way (EXP111 s4 rule)

units.primary: 16 small pallets of the 8 new dev layouts, frame 0 only
units.repeatability: frames 1-2: same answer as frame 0 (state and colour set); never counted as extra samples
units.independent_unit: layout (8); statistics resample layouts (cluster bootstrap), never pallets or frames
units.correct: state (EMPTY/LOADED) correct on frame 0; an invalid output is not correct

errors.E3: colour set wrong on a pallet correctly judged LOADED
errors.E4: a floor block next to the pallet reported on the pallet (diagnostic, overlaps E1/E3)
errors.E7: invalid output (format); never counted as A or B and never as correct
errors.consequence: recorded separately from the error type: for every pallet with an error and every destination query of its layout, the selection is recomputed with only that pallet replaced by the answer key. Same outcome -> no_effect. Different outcome -> wrong_selection if the actual outcome is wrong_target or false_select, abstain (safe failure) if it is missed, other otherwise.

screening_rule.fixed: 2026-11-15, user decision, before any EXP112 run
screening_rule.net: number of frame-0 pallets with correct state in the zoom condition minus the same number in Z-full (same 16 pallets)
screening_rule.eligible: B guard: (B_E2 + E7 invalid on loaded pallets) of the zoom condition <= the same count of Z-full, AND net >= k
screening_rule.choice: at most one of Z-crop, Z-both: the eligible one with the larger net; tie -> the smaller median per-call latency on frame 0
screening_rule.none_eligible: no condition is chosen; the dev result is reported as is
screening_rule.meaning: dev screening only; not statistical significance and not hypothesis proof. The independent test criterion is fixed separately before the test run.
screening_rule.b_guard_note: v4 supplement: an invalid answer on a loaded pallet is not counted as B (it is E7), so with the v3 guard a condition could lower B by producing invalid outputs instead of 'empty'. The guard therefore counts loaded pallets that were not confirmed as loaded for either reason. net already counts invalid as not correct.
screening_rule.v3_eligible: B_E2 count of the zoom condition <= B_E2 count of Z-full AND net >= k

bootstrap.use: descriptive CI of net (layout clusters), not a pass rule

destination_analysis: Python selects from the per-pallet answers for 'the empty pallet', 'the pallet with blocks', 'the pallet with the blue block', 'the pallet with the red block' (EXP120 resolve rule) and compares with the same selection on the answer-key states (definitional, no geometry constants)
